title: Cadonilimab plus chemotherapy as first-line treatment in PD-L1-negative advanced non-small cell lung cancer: a phase II clinical trial.
caption: Anti-tumor activity and treatment duration. a  Waterfall plot of best percentage change from baseline of sum of target lesion diameters.  b  Spider plot of percentage change from baseline of sum of target lesion diameters.  c  Swimmer plot of treatment duration and best overall response.
